## Findings

- [ ] **[Repo/WARN] Merge policy not enforced — all three merge methods enabled**
  - **Status quo:** `mergeCommitAllowed`, `squashMergeAllowed` and `rebaseMergeAllowed` are all `true` (verified via `gh repo view`). Merges therefore happen by whichever method the merger happens to click; with `required_linear_history` active on main, merge commits are rejected at push time, which makes the `merge` button an inconsistent trap.
  - **Proposed solution:** In Settings → General, enable only `squash merge` (matching `required_linear_history`), or alternatively keep two methods deliberately and document the policy in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / low impact.

- [ ] **[Protection/WARN] Admin bypass: `enforce_admins` disabled + stale disabled ruleset "main protection"**
  - **Status quo:** `repos/…/branches/main/protection` shows `enforce_admins.enabled: false` — the repo owner (sole admin) can push to main directly and merge PRs without the required `build-and-test`/`render-smoke` checks. Additionally a ruleset named "main protection" (id 18313859) exists with `enforcement: disabled`, a dead configuration that will confuse future edits (branch protection is the active mechanism).
  - **Proposed solution:** Decide deliberately: either enable `enforce_admins` (strict; recommended once a second maintainer exists) or keep the bypass and document it. Delete the disabled ruleset so only one mechanism is visible.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / low impact (solo repo today; revisit when shared).

- [ ] **[Labels/WARN] Missing `auto-blocked` label while the auto-* protocol is in use**
  - **Status quo:** `auto-claimed`, `auto-failed`, `auto-pr`, `auto-skip`, `auto-stalled` exist, but `auto-blocked` does not. The coordination protocol is active in this repo (auto-* labels present, PRs labelled `auto-pr` in history).
  - **Proposed solution:** Create the label (`gh label create auto-blocked --color B60205 --description "Blocked issue: needs human input"`). Note: the workflow auto-creates missing labels on first use, so this self-heals; creating it now just removes the gap.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / low impact.

- [ ] **[Release/WARN] HEAD is 43 commits ahead of the latest release v0.3.0**
  - **Status quo:** Latest release `v0.3.0` (2026-07-28); `git rev-list --count HEAD v0.3.0` = 43. The v0.4.0 prerelease gate evidence is already recorded in `.github/prerelease/2026-08-03T09-44-19Z.md`.
  - **Proposed solution:** Run the release pipeline for v0.4.0 (`/06-gh-prerelease` → `/07-gh-release`). The tag scheme (vX.Y.Z) and release notes are in good shape.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / medium impact.
